name: Welcomer
description: Greets new members in a channel you choose, and says goodbye when they leave.
about: Whenever someone joins your server, the bot posts a message that mentions them in the channel you pick. It's a normal Send message block, so you can change the text or turn it into an embed with the member's avatar. When a member leaves, it posts a goodbye in the same channel. Uncheck the leave listener if you only want welcomes.
To see new members, your bot needs the Server Members Intent. It's one switch under Bot in the Discord Developer Portal.

faq.question: What does the bot need to welcome members?
faq.answer: The Server Members Intent, which you turn on under Bot in the Discord Developer Portal, and permission to send messages in the welcome channel.

faq.question: Can I welcome members with a DM instead?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace the Send message block with a direct message block in the editor, or keep both.

faq.question: Can new members get a role too?
faq.answer: Yes. Add an Add role to member block after the message. If members should click a button before they get the role, use the Verification template instead.

parameters.label: Channel
parameters.description: The channel to send the welcome and leave messages to.
